name: camayoc_wf_run_state_as_of
description: workflow-and-archive Q2: what state a run was in at an instant, read from the append-only transition log — the latest transition at or before the instant, and its toState. Answered from TransitionEvents rather than by valid-time slicing the re-asserted aegis:currentState facts: the two return the same state, the transition log is the truth currentState is derived from, and this form is answerable without a bitemporal store. BEFORE THE FIRST TRANSITION THERE IS NO ROW. That absence is the answer — the run's state before it was ever transitioned is not recorded, and returning a starting state nobody wrote would be inventing one.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?state ?event ?observedAt FROM <{window}> WHERE { ?event a aegis:TransitionEvent ; aegis:inRun <{run}> ; aegis:toState ?state ; aegis:observedAt ?observedAt . FILTER(?observedAt <= "{instant}") FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?later a aegis:TransitionEvent ; aegis:inRun <{run}> ; aegis:observedAt ?laterAt . FILTER(?laterAt <= "{instant}" && ?laterAt > ?observedAt) } }
